# GC AI app UI — observed 2026-11-22 (app.gc.ai, logged-in trial, read-only)

## Tokens (computed, light theme `theme--legacy`)
- Font: Inter (sans, display, serif all = Inter). Body 16px. Headings navy, h1 24/700, h2 20/600.
- Canvas bg `--background` #f4f5f1 (cream) · card/surface #fefeff · muted/secondary #ede2d8 (stone-200) · stone #f1ebe3
- Foreground #061118 (midnight) · heading #173c51 (navy-700) · secondary text #494849
- Primary/accent #173c51 navy, on-primary #f4f5f1 · accent-hover #4398c4 · accent-soft #e4f5fc · ring #7ec5e6
- Border default rgba navy 0.14 (#15394e/0.14), subtle 0.08, strong 0.28; `--border` #c5b4a5, input #dccfc0, row border #e5e5e5
- Status pairs (surface/foreground): red #f5e3df/#8d2e24 · orange #f7e6d7/#8e4a15 · yellow #f5eccb/#7b5a11 · green #e7efe5/#3f6b4a · teal #dfedea/#1f5d53 · blue #e0ebf1/#24516f · purple #eae4f0/#55407d · neutral #f4f3e9
- success #377853 · danger #ab544a · info #3682aa
- Navy scale 900→050: #051924 #03212e #173c51 #314e5e #436271 #5c7d8b #87a7b5 #b8ced9 #dfebee #edf2f6
- Stone scale: 050 #fdf8f6 100 #f4f3e9 200 #ede2d8 300 #dccfc0 400 #c5b4a5 500 #a49483 600 #857869 700 #64584c
- Radius: sm 4 · md 6 (buttons) · lg 12 · xl 16 · base .5rem
- Shadows: navy-tinted, soft (xs 0 1px 2px navy/.06; sm 0 2px 6px/.07 + 0 1px 2px/.05; md 0 8px 24px -8px/.16)

## Layout + components
- 3-pane shell: left sidebar on cream (logo, ⌘K search pill, nav: New chat / Projects / Automations / Contract Intelligence / More, RECENTS small-caps label, footer user + trial badge); center = white rounded panel floating on cream; right panel (Skills | Files segmented tabs, search + "+ New" navy button, filter pills, collapsible small-caps groups with counts, star toggles).
- Buttons: primary navy filled, 34px tall, 6px radius, 14px/500. Secondary: outlined pills/rect with icons (filter pills "All", "Group: Owner").
- Segmented controls (Daily/Weekly/Monthly…), circular day toggles (navy filled = on), info callout on stone bg (#ede2d8-ish) with ⓘ icon.
- Forms: label above, light-bordered inputs, textarea; composer with bottom toolbar (+, company profile select with building icon, project select with folder icon, tag chips "Labels"/"Connectors").
- Page header: title + one-line description left, primary action right; filter pill row; Grid/List toggle.
- Chat answer: "Worked for X ▾" collapsible trace → steps with icons + durations → markdown report; tables with stone/beige header row, rounded border; numbered citation superscripts in soft circles; follow-up suggestion chips (outlined, rounded) above composer.
- Home: centered greeting heading in navy with ↵ glyph, composer, "Ideas for you" list with icon tiles.
- Empty state: centered bold title + one line + navy button.
- Relevant product concepts: **Company profile** (selectable per chat/automation), **Automations** (scheduled chats w/ skills + profile + weekly schedule + email/Slack delivery), Skills library includes "Regulatory Monitor".

I went through GC AI's app (chat, home, Automations and the new-automation form), read-only. The notes are saved at /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-anfal-Projects-hobby-projects-gc-ai-swe-take-home/a08edfc1-fb15-42ae-bd51-4713e62c11e0/scratchpad/gcai-ui-notes.md.

Their look is Inter everywhere, a cream background (#f4f5f1) with white panels floating on it, navy (#173c51) for primary buttons and headings, and stone/beige for table headers and callouts. Buttons are compact (34px tall, 6px corners) and shadows are soft with a navy tint. Status badges come in paired background/text colours: red, orange, yellow and green, which map neatly onto our four tiers. The layout is three panes:

┌ cream sidebar ┐┌──── white panel ─────────────┐┌ right panel ───┐
│ logo, ⌘K      ││ "Worked for X ▾" → steps     ││ Skills | Files │
│ New chat      ││ report + stone-header tables ││ search  [+New] │
│ Automations   ││ follow-up chips              ││ filter pills   │
│ RECENTS       ││ composer: [company profile▾] ││ grouped lists  │
└───────────────┘└──────────────────────────────┘└────────────────┘

Two of their existing concepts line up with our Settings screen almost one-to-one:

  • Company profile: a dropdown with a building icon in the composer. That's our preset picker.
  • Automations: a weekly-schedule form with Daily/Weekly toggle buttons, a beige "Runs every weekday at 8:00" note, and email/Slack delivery. That's our week picker and run options.

So for hi-fi I'd put our three GC screens inside that three-pane layout and reuse those exact patterns. I'd keep our own name, "Reg Monitor", and leave out their logo, so it reads as built for GC AI rather than as a copy of their product. Want me to go ahead with hi-fi on that basis?

  /** Jev (decision model): returns a probability only. Every call is traced with what it was asked. */
  async jev(state: string, question: string, documentNumber: string): Promise<{ p: number; cost: number; ms: number }> {
    this.guard();
    const t0 = Date.now();
    const model = experiment().jevModel;
    const r = await decide({
      model: decisionModel(model),
      state,
      questions: { relevant: { type: "boolean", instructions: question } },
      maxRetries: 3,
    });

Here's the POC stack, read from package.json and the code:

Layer POC uses
App Next.js 16.4 (App Router), React 19.3, TypeScript 5
UI Tailwind 4.3, shadcn 4 on Base UI (11 components already in src/components/ui), lucide icons, Recharts 3.8
LLM calls Vercel AI SDK 7, routed through the Vercel AI Gateway (one key)
Models Sonnet 5.5 for filter, date extraction and action text; Jev (typesafe-ai/jev, via the AI SDK's decide) to rank relevance and pick passages; the arena also ran GPT-6.2 Sol, Gemini 4 Carbon and Kimi K3.1 Pro
Judges Opus 5.5, GPT-6.2 Sol and Gemini 4 Carbon; 2 of 3 must agree
Search Each vendor's own web search for the baseline, and the Gateway's Exa search where a vendor has none; web leads are off in the pipeline
Data Federal Register API plus govinfo full text, cached on disk; config in YAML validated with zod; runs and traces stored as JSON/JSONL files
Tests and tooling Vitest 5, ESLint 9, tsx for the scripts, pnpm 9

Do we bring Flue/Pi into the build, or keep the AI SDK pipeline and change the RFC?
